local_certificate_scope: all nonzero centered local pairs with local free l1 below target_l1
global_certificate_statement: For the direct sum of 16 identical certified pair blocks, every nonzero global free vector activates a certified local slice; therefore SystematicLeeDistanceAtLeast q P target_l1 holds globally when passes_target is true.
notes: Certificate covers a block-diagonal direct sum of identical two-coordinate shared-row blocks.
Each local pivot row reads both local free coordinates, so rows are shared within a pair but not across blocks.
Pass means every centered local pair with free l1 below target was checked and none had total Lee l1 below target.
For the direct-sum global matrix, nonzero global y activates at least one local block and the local Lee norm is a sub-sum of the global Lee norm.
That local-to-global step is represented in Lean by productBlockComposableSystematicLeeCertificate.
